vulnerability_title: [M-08] Reduce-only orders can be used to inflate `quoteOI` and DoS the orderbook

recommendation.recommendation_text:
Skip updating `quoteOI`/`baseOI` for reduce-only orders or enforce notional and price caps relative to mark price so attackers cannot inflate open interest with extreme values.

[View detailed Proof of Concept](https://code4rena.com/audits/2025-08-gte-perps-and-launchpad/submissions/F-161)
